title: Soul Snack #45: Energy Into Matter
excerpt: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day.
bodyHtml:
Learn how to connect with your intuition every day. Click here to start your journey to authentic power!

In this thought-provoking Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explains how your intentions create your reality – literally. Drawing from a multisensory perception now available to our species, Gary illustrates how the choice of intention is the powerful force that shapes the Light that flows through you into the matter of your life.

Whether your intention comes from a frightened part or a loving part of your personality, each choice creates your experiences and the unfolding of your personal karma.

Gary explains the relationship between your soul and your personality, showing how each choice of intention creates your reality. He explains that your actions and words are carriers of your intent, which is often unconscious. When you make a responsible choice to act from a loving part of your personality, you create experiences that nourish your soul. But when you react from a frightened part, you create experiences of separation, pain, and a struggle for external power.

Ultimately, this episode reminds us that every responsible choice is an opportunity to create a reality aligned with the intentions of your soul: harmony, cooperation, sharing, and reverence for Life. The power to transform your life is yours, and it begins with your conscious choice to act from a loving part of your personality.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

(00:02) – Two Worlds, One Choice: Why we’re living in a time of transition between the old consciousness of external power and the new consciousness of authentic power—and how your intention determines which reality you create.

(01:10) – What Intention Really Means: The difference between unconsciously reacting from a frightened part and consciously choosing the intention of a loving part of your personality.

(03:50) – The Power of Emotional Awareness: How paying attention to the physical sensations in your energy centers allows you to become conscious of your choices and create with intention.

(06:08) – How Intention Shapes Reality: Why every loving or fearful intention you choose shapes the Light that flows through you into the matter of your life.

(08:53) – Soul and Personality: Understanding the relationship between your personality and your immortal soul on its journey of evolution in the Earth school.

(10:20) – The Path to Authentic Power: How making a responsible choice to act from a loving part of your personality is the path to creating authentic power.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think about a moment when your reaction created a reality you didn’t intend. Did you act from anger, fear, or judgment? Now revisit that moment and ask: What would it have looked like to choose an intention of love instead? What reality might you have created? Each moment is an opportunity to bring a new world into being – energy into matter – through the power of conscious intention.
